hypothesis: Evaluate independent modulo-4 input lanes in two phases. Phase one reduces a+b per output before phase two computes c+d. This preserves each lane's additions and final (a+b)+(c+d) order, with fewer live partial sums and no duplicate reads of a packed byte.
gate: Exactness, zero reported allocations, at least 5% improvement vs main pair on at least three 4-worker shapes, and no >5% regression vs main pair in any cell. To replace the current direct-quad candidate on this host, additionally improve on it by >=5% in at least three 4-worker cells, with no >5% regression on any cell.
execution: Furnace P-cores 4–7, GOMAXPROCS=4. Same 200ms bench time and four samples per cell and variant. Separate Mac M4 diagnostic using the same harness.
followup: If Linux micro gate passes, compare split candidate against main on the same cached models and retain the original comparison separately.
